# `network/realm/link/DiscoveryProvider.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/link/DiscoveryProvider.js`

Realm discovery is an orchestration contract, not a new discovery network. Providers adapt the existing bootstrap, DHT, invite, contact, peer-ticket, and Masterserver mechanisms into one bounded result shape.

## Functions

### `normalizeDiscoveryCandidate(candidate, { sourceId, now = Date.now()`

Normalize an untrusted provider result into the Realm discovery shape.

### `createDiscoveryProvider({ id, kind = DISCOVERY_KIND.CUSTOM, priority = 0, discover, advertise = null, revoke = null, health = null, } = {})`

Define one discovery provider. Network algorithms remain in the adapted subsystem.

### `async discoverRealmPeers(registry, query = {}, { timeoutMs = 5000, correlationId = null } = {})`

Query all enabled providers concurrently; one provider failure never erases valid peer results.

### `discoveryProviderStatus(registry)`

### `createBootstrapRegistryProvider({ id = 'bootstrap', registry, priority = 10 } = {})`

Adapt the existing ordered bootstrap registry without reproducing its scan logic.

### `createPeerTicketDiscoveryProvider({ id = 'peer-tickets', store, priority = 100 } = {})`

Adapt the existing signed peer-ticket store into discovery hints.

### `createDhtDiscoveryProvider({ id = 'dht', transport, priority = 20 } = {})`

Adapt the existing mesh DHT query transport; callers choose exactly one query key.
